tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs bya tshul tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len ltar bklags chog tu bkod pa bde chen sprin sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma mchog dang mkha' spyod dbang mo la// gus pas btud nas snod ldan slob ma rnams// rdo rje btsun mo'i nye lam la bkri phyir// byin rlabs cho ga bde chen sprin sgra brjod// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho gas slob ma rjes 'dzin bya ba la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ tshes bcu gnyis kyi dus dang bstun nas tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i nye lam dang*/ gnas gsar bas mdzad pa'i nag 'gros sgrub dkyil gsal ba'i me long sogs tshar lugs bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes dang mthun pa'i cho ga tshang ba byas te/ bdag 'jug gi mjug yon gyi maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i mthar yi dam chos srung rnams kyi gtor 'bul tshogs 'khor rnams kyang rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar go rim ma 'khrul bar nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ don du gnyer ba'i slob ma sngar dbang gis smin pa dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa lam 'di'i rnal 'byor ma mtha' 'ang dam bca' gang byas kyi oṃ gsum ma chag med bzla nus pa gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa rnams la dbang khang gi sgor spos kyis bdug cing khrus kyi slad du chab kyis kha bshal du bcug nang du bos nas bslab pa sogs rgan rim gyis gral du 'khod pa la las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu byas te/ 'bru'i phyed phar bsdus shing phyed lag tu bzung ba snyim pa stong par mi 'gro ba'i ched yin no// de yang bla ma kha cig bgegs gtor bsngo ba mdzad kyin 'dug ste/ de lta bu byas pas 'gal ba med cing phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gro srid mod/

'on kyang sa skya'i phyogs su byed pa nyung bas/ ma byas kyang chog ste/ tshar lugs bla ma gong ma'i phyag len la'ang med do// de nas slob dpon gyis dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos khyab par byas la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan pos 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// ༈ /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs zab mo gsan la/ lam gyi snying po bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor chag med du nyams su bzhes snyam pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed legs par gsal 'debs pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang*/ skyes rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal gyis nye bar gnas// dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis lta// tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// gus pa bskyed la rtse gcig btud// rab tu dwangs la dri med yid// nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin// rim gro bskyed la chos nyon cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa theg pa chen po thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rgyud sde dag las 'byung ba bzhin/ gnas khang 'di nyid kyang dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ slob dpon nged kyang pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la bzhugs pa'i 'bras dus kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal nas grag stong skye ba med pa'i chos kyi rang sgra lhang lhang sgrogs par mos te/ yid gzhan du ma yengs par khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i ngang nas gsan par zhu/ gsan bya dam pa'i chos ni bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya so so'i khams dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal dang mthun par chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du dgos pa las/

da lan 'dir theg pa chen po yin zhing de la dbye na/ ji skad du/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi// 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas// rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus su 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'gyur ba las 'dir phyi ma yin/ de la pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyis ni rgyu 'dra bas 'bras bu 'dra ba sgrub par mi nus te/ rgyu la yun ring mo zhig 'gor zhing 'bras bu 'phral du mi 'grub pa'i phyir rgyu'i theg pa zhes bya/ sngags kyi theg pas ni 'bras bu da lta nyid nas lam du byed cing*/ de nyid myur du 'grub pa'i phyir 'bras bu'i theg pa ces bya ba yin la/ slob dpon ka ma la shī la'i tshul gsum gyi sgron ma las kyang*/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes mdo sngags gnyis rtogs bya'i lta ba/ thob bya'i 'bras bu/ kun slong byang chub kyi sems rnams mtshan nyid gcig kyang*/ rtogs bya'i lta ba la ma rmongs pa dang*/ rtogs byed kyi thabs mang ba dang*/ dbang po rnon po'i dbang du bya ba dang*/ dka' ba med par byang chub bsgrub pa ste tshul bzhi'i sgo nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags tshul gsungs pa lags/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyud sde rin po che de'ang*/ drug dang bdun du dbye ba dang*/ gsum dang gnyis su bsdu ba dang*/ lnga dang bzhir bzhag pa sogs paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi bzhes srol mi 'dra ba byung yang*/ grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brangs nas rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams gdul bya sbyangs pa che 'bring chung gsum la dgongs nas gsang sngags mtha' dag rgyud sde bzhir bsdus nas bshad pa nyid legs par bzhed cing*/

de'i lung yang rdo rje gur gyi rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes gsungs pa 'di la gtso bor brten nas mdzad pas de'i phyogs bzung ste bshad na/ gang zag blo dman pa sbyangs pa chung ba khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' zhing phyi lus ngag gi bya ba tsam gtso bor 'dod pa la bya rgyud/ des blo sbyongs cung zad che bas phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang*/ nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod par 'dod pa la spyod rgyud/ gang zag sbyangs pa 'bring du gyur pa ting nge 'dzin gtso bor bsgom nus pa la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ sbyangs pa'am dbang po yang rab kyi mchog tu gyur pa ting nge 'dzin bla na med pa rkyen bzang ngan thams cad lam du khyer shes pa lta bu la rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gsungs pa ste/ de'i nang nas da res gsan par bya ba ni bla med kyi rgyud yin/ de la'ang sgyu lus sam/ thabs rtsal du ston pa pha rgyud/ 'od gsal lam shes rab rtsal du ston pa ma rgyud/ zung 'jug gam thabs shes dbyer med dbang bzhi pa nyid kyi don rtsal du ston pa gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'dod pa las/ 'dir rnal 'byor ma bla na med pa'i sbas don mthar thug 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud rnams yin la/ de yang rje btsun sa skya pa dag rtsa rgyud nag po'i skor/ kun spyod lū hi'i skor/ zab don dril bu'i skor/ zab pa'i yang rtse nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skor dang bzhir bzhed pa'i phyi ma ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u zhe bdun par yum la brten nas dngos grub bsgrub pa'i tshul gsungs shing*/ le'u zhe brgyad par yum gyi nye snying dang*/ le'u bdun pa brgyad par snying po phan yon dang bcas pa/ lnga bcu par de nyid kyi las tshogs bcu gnyis bka' stsal te de dag gi man ngag snying por gyur pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis jo bo nā ro ta pa la gnang ba'i khyad chos/

nā ro ta pas grags chen gyi slob ma gzhan su la'ang ma gnang bar bal po pham thing pa sku mched kho na la gnang ba'i gdams pa/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la rnal 'byor bla med dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu bzhugs pa'i nang nas mchog sgrub kyi gser chos dmar mo skor gsum du grags pa'i snying po/ zab pa las kyang ches cher zab pa snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan kha'u brang rdzong pa'i phyag bzhes ltar byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du 'bul ba la/ gang gis skur bar byed pa slob dpon ni spyir rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba dang khyad par du/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang po'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge las/ 'di'i bsnyen sgrub legs par song ba/ gzhan don du slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i sngon du kha gso'i bsnyen sgrub byas nas gnang ba thob pa'o zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// tha na'ang bsnyen pa sngon du song ba chag med rgyun du byed pa zhig dgos/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni/ rab bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ 'bring bde mchog yab bka' gang rigs/ tha ma kye rdor man ngag lugs sogs ma rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor du rgyu dus kyi dbang legs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba la brtson pa/ lam 'di'i byin rlabs dang chos skor don du gnyer ba nyams len chag med byed 'dod pa zhig la bstan par bya ba yin/ gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs sam// chu bo chen po'i ngogs dag dang*// gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du// der ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i gnas snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben pa zhig tu bya bar bshad/ nam bya ba'i dus ni rgyud las/ dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// ces gsungs pas gtso bor 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa la mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/

mthun rkyen bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsog par byed pa la yar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis su yod pa las/ da lan yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de las gzhan pa'i tshes grangs la mi bya ste dus tshes ma dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro zhes bla ma dag gsung ngo*// tshul ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa la/ sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi las dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis kyi dang po la bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod bstod bya ba/ bum pa bsgrub cing sngags bzlas pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ gtor ma dang tshogs mchod dgos pa rnams legs par grub par bgyis zin nas/ gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun gyis/ dad pa med pa'i sems kyis ni// legs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir bzlog ltar// dad pas bskrun pa'i sems kyis ni// phan pa'i sems kyis 'dir 'jug bya// zhes bshad pas 'dir rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor ye nas gnas pa de/ byin rlabs zab mo'i sgo nas ngo sprad/ dus der nyams su myong ba de la nges shes bskyed nas de'i rgyun skyong ba lam gyi snying po yin zhing*/ de la bla ma dang yi dam la yid ches khyad par can gyi dad pa drag po ma skyes na nyams su myong ba mi skye bas de'i slad du mos gus bcos ma ma yin pas kun nas slong la/ maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐ nas brlab tu gsol gyi bar slob mar byar gzhug de ltar rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa yon du phul nas/ phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ snying gi dkyil rkang gi khong nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de yang tshigs bcad dang po gang gi drin gyis sogs kyis bla ma dang*/

dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsol ba btab nas/ lhag ma tshig rkang gnyis kyis byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa la dmigs nas don zhu ba yin no// de ltar nges par mdzad nas gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces lan gsum bya/ 'di'i gang drin ma bde mchog gi bshad rgyud kun spyod dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa'i tshigs bcad sgyu ma chen mo'i rgyud las 'byung ngo*// de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ byin rlabs dngos la sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba gnyis/ dang po la yang phyi 'jug dang nang 'jug gnyis su yod pas/ phyi'i 'jug pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid kun rdzob sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam par shar ba ma rig pas bsgribs nas ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mas ras yug dmar po res gdong bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis bcing*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas me tog gi phreng ba re phyag tu gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gtad/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las khro mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing ku shas bum chu 'thor dril bu gsil/ de ltar phyi'i bar chad bsal nas bdud rtsi lce la myangs pas lus sems bde bas gang*/

nang gi bar chad thams cad dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod bdud rtsi sbyin/ rigs dang 'dun pa 'dri ba 'di dag gsan pas khyab par gda'/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can bde chen la 'dun cing dga' snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la'o// ched du bya ba 'dri ba'i don/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i lan du sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par 'dod do zhes lan btab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /de la nang gi sems bskyed pa mdzad dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sems can thams cad la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrub par bgyi'o// de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dung ba zhig skyed mdzod/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang lta bu zhig lam gyis byung bar mos pa mdzod/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam du yid la byas te/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig gsal lam gyis byung bar mos te/ mdor na khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i ngo bor gnas pa de gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ de lta bu'i thams cad rnal 'byor gyi sems bskyed pa de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du brtan par bya ba'i phyir du bla ma rnal 'byor mas phyag gi rdo rje snying gar bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/

su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra yā tha su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ ches shin tu gsang ba'i gnad 'di lta bu dag ni/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa'am/ ldan yang dad pa med pa la smra bar bya ba ma yin no// zhes bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsang bar gdams pa 'dir gda'/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes rdo rje mgo thog tu bzhag nas dril bu gsil/ slob dpon rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i phyag na gnas pa'i rdo rje la 'jus te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i drung du sleb par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de rnams kyis phyi'i 'jug pa song nas gnyis pa nang 'jug gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khod nas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bshags yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ 1 'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang ngo snyam pa dang*/ 2 sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar brten pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can de bdag gis kyang bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yid dam bca' ba dang*/ 3 yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/

4 bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya'o snyam pa smon pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ 5 de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa'i bdag nyin can dang*/ 6 de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba ste/ 7 don de rnams yid la dran pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rje yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig gong 'phel du bzung ba'i don la 'di ltar nges pa gal che ste/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs sh+lau ka phyed dang gnyis kyis sdom pa gzung ba'i yul dang*/ 'dzin par byed pa'i gang zag dang*/ dus ji tsam gyi bar du gzung ba rnams smos pa yin la/ gzung bya'i tshul dngos la rigs lnga spyi'i sdom pa gzung ba/ so so'i sdom pa gzung ba/ don bsdus te dam bca'i tshul gyis gzung ba dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar dus gsum sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis smon sems gzung ba/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi snying po/

nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum po 'dzin pa ste/ de dag rigs lngas bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas so// gnyis pa so so'i dam tshig la/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin pa rnam snang gi dam tshig tu bstan pa yin te/ rnam snang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo tshul khrims rnam dag gi rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba yang sdom pa'i tshul khrims thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas so// rdo rje'i rigs mchog sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya slob dpon te/ bzhi po rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig tu bstan pa yin te/ mi bskyod pa rnam g.yeng dag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo yin pa ltar/ dam tshig gsum dang slob dpon bsgom pa yang ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso bo yin pas so// rin chen rigs mchog sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams pa'i sbyin pa bzhi po nyin mtshan dus drug tu dngos sam/ yid kyis 'dun par bya ba rin 'byung gi dam tshig tu bstan pa yin te/ rin 'byung ser sna rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pa ltar/ sbyin pa yang dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*/ ser sna'i gnyen po yin pas so// byang chub chen po sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis phyi bya spyod/ nang rnal 'byor rgyud/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla med de rgyud sde bzhi dang nyan rang byang sems te theg pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i mdor na chos ma lus pa 'dzin pa 'od dpag med pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig tu bstan pa yin te/ 'od dpag med gsung rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pa ltar/ chos kyang gsung gis ston par byed pas so// las kyi rigs mchog sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis/ sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang*/ mchod pa'i las ci nus byed pa gnyis don yod grub pa'i dam tshig tu bstan pa yin te/

don grub brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo/ phrin las kyi rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ dge ba la brtson zhing sdom pa 'dzin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la mchod pa byed pa de ka sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rjes su skyong ba yin pas so// gsum pa don bsdus te dam bca'i tshul gyis gzung ba la/ byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis/ smon pa dang 'jug pa sems bskyed mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis sdom pa ji snyed gzung bar dam bca' ba dang*/ sh+lau ka phyi mas rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i tshogs las ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa las ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ngo zhes don bsdus nas khas len pa yin pas so// de rnams yid la dran bzhin du de'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di gsang ming dran nas ming

brjod pa na rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni zhes gsung rgyun no/ zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnams bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dam pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum byar gzhug go /khyad par du bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le'u nyer drug pa las/ de nas rnal 'byor rgyud du ni// rnyed dka'i dam tshig nga yis bshad// skyes pa bud med g.yon nas 'gro// 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar byed// ces pa nas/

khro med bu gar kun tu spyod// 'di brgyad dam tshig kun spyod yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa'i g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyi dam tshig dang*/ spyir bud med la mi smod pa dang*/ khyad par shes rab ma la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bde mchog gi dam tshig brgyad pa dang*/ dam tshig brgyad ni g.yon pa'i kun spyod dang 1 */ 'dzag bde la sred nas las rgya bsten pa dang 2 */ bdag gzhan mnyam nyid kyi lta ba dran pa dang 3 */ bla na med pa'i lam la the tshom za ba dang 4 */ phyag rgya spong ba dang 5 */ phyag rgya dang 'bral bar byed pa dang 6 */ kun tu mi bsrung ba dang 7 */ phyag rgya'i bdud rtsir mi gtsang bar 'du shes kyis spong ba dang brgyad yin no/ thun mong ba rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang*/ sbom po'i ltung ba brgyad dril bas nyi shu rtsa gnyis po rnams gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo sku gsung thugs gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo sngags kyi dge 'dun dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' nye sras brgyad sogs bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*// lan gsum bya/ de dag gis sngon 'gros rgyud sbyang ba song nas/ nang 'jug dngos gzhi la phyi nang gsal ba'i phag mo ngo sprad cing ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/

bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum bya zhing maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab 'di bsdu na ma byas kyang chog go /don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal lam/ gzhi dus kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid skye 'gro thams cad la khyab par bzhugs na yang*/ kun rdzob bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gis ngo ma shes par nga dang nga yir bzung ba la brten nas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pa kho nar 'dug pas/ 'khor 'das kyi gzhi ma sems nyid rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa kun tu sbyangs dgos shing de nyid don gyi sdom par nges pa'i shes pa brtan po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam smin gdos bcas kyi sha rus kyi bar du sbyangs te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi go sar e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas tshur 'dus/ yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams re re bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/

sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar e e las byung ba'i chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po/ mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re re yod par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched rags pa gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin du gnas pa thabs 'dis gsal btab cing ngo sprad nas/ nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ngo shes pa'i slad du bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon rin po ches bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs dang*/ yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum bya/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas/ de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa gcig dmar hril gyis byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas khar thogs med du zhugs par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ting lo'i mar me de nyid oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod cing*/ slob ma'i khar bla ma rang nyid kyis gzhug go /rnal 'byor ma de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs mdzad cing yar 'khyug mar 'khyug mdzad pa'i mthar lte ba'i bam̐ yig la thim pas/ de nyid rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nyid phyi'i rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

khyed rang rnams kyi ma las thob pa'i dmar cha a thung shad kyi rnam pa can/ 'di pa'i lugs la lte ba'i bam̐ yig de nyid gdod ma nas nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pas/ de thabs 'dis gsal btab cing ngo sprad pa yin no// de nas gsang ba bde stong dbyer med kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ngo shes pa'i slad du ye shes dbab dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams kyis dges pa'i gar mdzad/ sngags kyi sgra chen po sgrog cing*/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs drag tu brjod cing*/ ḍā dril dkrol/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang rje btsun ma'i sku dpag tu med pa byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngar bzhin sngags dang rol mo bya ba ni phyi'i rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs pa'i sgo nas dbab pa yin gsungs te sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas gsang gnas kyi bar du/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po sbubs stong sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam pa'i mas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dmar po g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor bas dbu ma'i nang nas bya 'phur ba bzhin snying ga'i thad du song bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dbu ma'i yas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dkar po g.yas skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba/ dbu ma'i nang du mar 'khor bzhin pas snying ga'i thad du byung bas snang ba thams cad stong nyid kyi ngang du thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

dga' 'khyil de gnyis snying gar ro gcig tu 'dres pas bde stong gnyis med kyi ngo bo dga' 'khyil dmar skya shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad cing*/ mthar de nyid kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin smra bsam brjod med kyi ngang la ji tsam gnas kyi bar mnyam par bzhag pa ni gsang ba bde stong dbyer med kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ngo sprad pa yin zhes gsungs pas dhu dhur gu h+ya sā mā ya/ de ltar byin rlabs zhugs pa de rnams mi 'bral zhing brtan par gyur pa'i don du khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sngar bkod pa'i go cha'i sngags rnams dran zhing gsal 'debs par zhu/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces tshar gcig slob dpon gyis brjod cing*/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas byin rlabs kyi myong ba brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ bka' drin dran pas sngar phyag tu gtad pa'i me tog de rin po che'i phreng bar dmigs te rje btsun ma'i dbu'am/ thugs kar phul bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dor ba'i stangs ka tsam byar gzhug me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rje btsun mas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag nas dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod cing slob ma'i spyi bor gtad la/ me tog gi phreng ba'i dbang ngam byin rlabs kyi thog ma 'di nas zin pa'o// de ltar sems dang bam̐ lhan cig skyes pa'i phag mor ye nas gnas pa de cho ga de dag gis gsal bar byas pas dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sgrib byed bsal ba'i mtshon byed gdong g.yogs bkrol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur bas// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥtraṃḥ

kye khyed rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor la ltos zhes gsungs shing bltas pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de yang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gsum rim gyi 'og gi 'di nyid sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i gsang ba mtshon byed yin/ de'i steng na gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi gsang ba mtshon byed yin/ de'i steng na thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kyi gsang ba mtshon byed yin la/ mdor na de rnams gcig tu bsdoms pas 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng*/ srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong byung snyam du mdzod/ de dag gis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song*/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur bar byed pa la/ thog mar slob dpon dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la byin rlabs dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi nas byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas yon phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig

/lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phub/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur pa'i ngang nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis phaiṃ zhes brjod pas slob dpon rang nyid dang mdun bskyed rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar bkra lam gyis byon pas he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ khaṇ+ḍa kā pa li sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis shes pa brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchod pa'i las rtsom/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me tog 'thor zhing dril bu gsil bas/ he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi klad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e wam̐ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li kā li gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ gyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// zhes brjod/ de nas gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis zla ba ltar dkar ba'i bum pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba yal 'dab dang bcas pa cung zad yo bar 'dzin pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ tsakra bī ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ kā kā s+ya/ u lu kā s+ya/ shwā na s+ya/ su ka ra s+ya/ ya ma dā dhi/ ya ma daṃ ṣ+ṭi ni/ ya ma ma thā ni/ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/

bum chu rlan zhing gsher ba'i rgyun de mi bskyod pa chu dbang*/ bum pa spyi bor thogs pa rin 'byung dbu brgyan/ chu rgyun gyis lus gang zhing bde bas tshim pa 'od dpag med rdo rje/ yul stong nyid la sems pa don grub dril bu/ chu lhag ma las rigs bdag grub pa rnam snang ming gi dbang ste rigs pa'i dbang lnga po 'dis mtshon no/ dbang lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas rang nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon dang rje btsun ma 'khor bcas kyi rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing sngags brjod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ me tog la sogs pa lngas kyang khyed rang rnams la mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod de dbang gi dngos gzhi'o// sngags kyi byin rlabs kyi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du thol thol byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i khar zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig gi mtha' skor du 'khod par mos la rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yi dam gyi lhar gzung snyam pas me tog 'thor zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/

de yang rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ chos kyi sku yang bud med gzugs can te// bud med gzugs kyis 'gro ba dag par byed// ces gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi sku nyid dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos shes rab ma'i gzugs su sprul nas 'gro ba rnams 'dren par mdzad pa ste/ bdag med ma dang rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa yin la/ khyad par rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di nyid ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog gi snying po mchog tu gsungs pas 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga thob phyin chad bzlas bsgom mi chag par byed pa dam tshig yin/ mkha' spyod bsgrub tshul mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs mod/ da lan bzlas bsgom rnam pa gnyis la brten nas bsgrub pa 'di gtso che bas/ khyod oṃ gsum ma'i bzlas pa grangs ji tsam re bgrang bar 'dod/ ces so sor dris te brgya rtsa nas nyi shu rtsa gcig gam nyung mtha' bdun la sogs pa'i grangs tig tig byar bcug de ltar na dam bca' ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag rig gsang ming dran pas chog pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma nyi ma re re bzhin du 'di snyed re bzla bar dam 'cha' lags so// sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon nas slob dpon gyis g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ khyod rang rnams kyi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su thig le byas pas sku'i dngos grub thams cad stsal zhing brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing reg pa dam tshig gsum ster ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang mtshon te/

bum dbang gi gnad byin rlabs kyi cho gas bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir ro// de ltar na sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag rnal 'byor ma'i sku bsgom pa la dbang zhing sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod nas rtogs pa bskyed do// gsang dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le thod pa'i nang du lhung ba slob dpon rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal bas khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor nas bdud rtsi ster/ gsang dbang gi rdzas de nyid mgrin pa'i lam nas myangs pas lus kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems dam tshig pa'i tshul du gnas pa dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rnal 'byor ma'i gsung sngags kyi bzlas brjod byed pa la dbang zhing*/ gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod nas rtogs pa bskyed do// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa dpal he ru kar gyur pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang ste bha ga'i nang du byin par sgoms mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas slob dpon gyis g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rtses blangs la oṃ gsum ma brjod cing lte ba/

snying ga mgrin pa/ dpral ba rnams su mas yar gyis thig le bya ste/ phyag len la/ bla ma'i g.yon gyi srin mdzub kyis blangs la/ slob ma'i srin mdzub g.yon la gtad nas des rang gi lte bar byug go /de ltar khyed rang rnams rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang gi byang chub kyi sems de nyid lte bar drangs pas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang*/ dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ de bzhin du snying gar drangs pas snying ga'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas mchog dga' ye shes nyams su myong*/ de bzhin du mgrin par drangs pas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas dga' bral gyi ye shes nyams su myong*/ de bzhin du spyi bor drangs pas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis khyab/ byang chub kyi sems la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la stong pas khyab/ bde stong zung 'jug lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myangs par mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs gnyis med kyi ye shes bsgom pa la dbang zhing thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing rtogs pa bskyed do// dbang bzhi pa'i don du bla ma'i gsung la brten nas gzhi 'bras ngos zin cing thob byung gi shes rab bskyed dgos pas don 'di dag la snyan gtod mdzod/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes pa'i don ni/ bden pa'i dngos po ye nas cung zad tsam yang yod ma myong ba chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bya ba ni/ yod med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ de'i ngo bo la gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa'i dri mas gos ma myong bas dri ma med pa/

de lta bu'i yul stong pa nyid dang*/ yul can gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i bde ba jo bo chen pos bde mchog lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs su dbang bzhi pa'i don bden gnyis zung 'jug la ngo sprod pas chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches legs bshad mchog tu bsngags par mdzad la/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhed pa de las ma 'khyogs pa zhig go/ chen po gnyis zung du 'jug pa de ni gnyis med ye shes kyi rdo rje yin te dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom zhes pa/ bden pa gnyis mi phyed pa zung 'jug gi ngang du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mtha' dag bsgom pa la dbang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de ltar byin gyis brlab pa'i dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ byin rlabs zab mo thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi nas brlab tu gsol gyi bar brjod/ der ma zad lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul gyi/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// lan gsum/ skabs 'dir kho bo'i bla ma maṅga'i mtshan can lo rgyus 'di spro ba bskyed pa'i don du gsung ba thob pas/ de bzhin byar spro na/

de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam 'di la brten nas rgya gar 'phags yul du/ grub chen dril bu pa/ nā ro ta pa/ a bha yā ka ra sogs grub thob bya khyu 'khur ba ltar byung ba'i tshul dang*/ bod gangs can 'dir yang*/ pu hrang lo chung lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod 'grub tshul/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i slob ma sgom pa mo'i lo rgyus dang*/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la mkha' spyod nas spyan 'dren byung tshul/ na bza' brag phug pa'i nye gnas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon tshul/ yang na bza' brag phug pa'i slob ma bdun lus ma spangs par song tshul/ grub chen bud+dha ba'i slob ma zhe dgon pa'i dge slong de wa ma ti nyer lnga la mkha' spyod mas spyan drangs tshul/ bla ma dam pa mkha' spyod mas rjes su bzung tshul/ sngags 'chang gzungs dpal la rnal 'byor mas byu ru dmar po'i skas dngos su btsugs tshul/ bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi gdung la rnal 'byor ma rang byon 'khrungs tshul/ bla chen chos dpal bas sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa byas pas khong gshegs dus rnal 'byor ma'i sku rang byon 'phel tshul/ khams pa bsod nams bzang po rnal 'byor mas mkha' spyod la dngos su khyer tshul/ shar chen ye rgyal la rnal 'byor mas/ 'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khyer// zhes pa'i lung bstan byung tshul/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma tsha ba rong pa shākya rgyal mtshan 'phan yul gyi ri las lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du song tshul/ yang tsha ba rong pa bsod nams bzang po/ tsha rong gi ri las mkha' spyod du song tshul/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i slob ma gsum mkha' spyod du dngos su song ba'i lo rgyus yod tshul/ paṇa chen gung ru mkha' spyod mas rjes su bzung tshul/ re tsag sangs rgyas bzang po la rje btsun ma'i rak+ta dbu zhwa'i nang du stsal tshul/ bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje'i gdung la oṃ gsum ma byon tshul/

sgrub chen seṅge grags gshegs dus sin+dhu ra'i char babs tshul/ srad pa kun blo la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mi'i bu mo dngos kyi rnam pa bstan tshul dang*/ khong byang chen du gshegs pa rnal 'byor mas bsu ba'i 'od zer dge ldan pas mthong bas sngar ma dad pa la 'gyod pas brang brdungs tshul/ pu hrang rnal 'byor pa la rnal 'byor mas bar chad bsal tshul dang gdung la sku rang byon 'phel tshul/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa la mnal lam du rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung tshul/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje tshal gung thang du bzhugs dus yer pa'i brag ngos nas zhal dngos su bstan tshul/ de'i dbon po lce btsun rin po che bsod nams mchog grub kyis rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim bsgoms pas lha'i me tog gi char dngos su babs tshul/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas tha mal pa'i bud med kyi tshul sogs rnam 'phrul du mas zhal dngos su yang yang bstan tshul/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la mnal lam du lung bstan byung tshul/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis 'phan yul du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar can gzigs tshul/ mus pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba la brten nas dbu gtsug 'phar zhing rtsa dbu ma lta bu'i sbom phra snyug ma 'bring po tsam gyi rtsa sbubs stong zhig rgyangs kyis 'thon pa las byang sems nyil le ba byung tshul/ rje btsun bka' 'gyur bas 'pho ba legs par thebs tshul sogs mdor na nā ro mkha' spyod 'di'i lam la brten nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma thob pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa zhig bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung sgros las byung bas skal bzang rnams 'di'i bzlas bsgom chags med du bgyid cing*/ dngos dang brgyud nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod cig bsod nams 'di yis sogs dge ba bsngo zhing*/
